svg.title: SRCNN / Complete experiment evolution
svg.desc: 153 experiments / 207 dependencies / snapshot 800a87a. Snapshot 800a87a. Experiment relationships are not Git ancestry.
svg.text: Solid: baseline, retry, integration. Dashed: references, controls, verification, reproduction.
Green: current stage passes (C/RTL is not routed timing); amber: HLS timing warning; red: budget/II/configuration/routing failure; teal: analysis.
Faded: failed/unrun/no functional pass. Bold: measured-stage metrics. HLS time is an estimate; B18 = BRAM18K; B36 = BRAM36; WNS = routed timing.

g.title: E000: Original floating-point baseline Preserve src/, network structure, and replicated edges; measure correctness and synthesis scale. Two full intermediate maps exceed BRAM capacity. Correct C simulation does not establish device fit. Over budget: BRAM18K HLS 19,601.13853 ms; DSP 10 / B18 11,064; LUT 9,377 / FF 8,027 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E010: Layer ranges and bit-width scan Measure ranges on 13 inputs and scan 16/12/10/8-bit weight and activation combinations. 10/10 bits lose about 0.0695 dB average PSNR; 8/8 bits lose about 5.18 dB. Missing comic prevents full Set14 acceptance. Analysis complete Software analysis Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E011: Real ap_fixed: 16/16 bits Check the software quantization model using AMD data types, with all supplied images planned. C simulation fails. Subsequent retries use separate IDs; this record is not a pass. Run failed No passing simulation Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E012: Real ap_fixed: 10/10 bits Validate the butterfly output of the complete fixed-point convolution network. This C simulation fails. Valid E017/E019 checks later establish the numerical evidence. Run failed No passing simulation Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E013: Real ap_fixed: 8/8 bits Check agreement between the quantization model and actual fixed-point arithmetic despite the failed quality gate. Arithmetic agreement does not imply acceptable quality; the all-8-bit design remains rejected. C simulation passed MSE 2.76e-3; C Pass / bit-exact Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E014: 16/16-bit full-dataset retry Retry complete ap_fixed simulation across the supplied images. Only some images finish within 45 minutes. Retain the timeout; do not claim a full-dataset pass. Timed out Timed out Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E018: 16/16-bit single-image control Limit complete ap_fixed arithmetic checks to butterfly; retain E010 as the separate multi-image quality evaluation. Compilation/simulation fails in this attempt; E015 retries it. Run failed No passing simulation Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E015: Valid 16/16-bit single-image retry Fix run configuration and validate complete ap_fixed butterfly arithmetic. The pass covers a single-image arithmetic check, not an actual 13-image full-ap_fixed run. C simulation passed MSE 1.21e-8; C Pass / bit-exact Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E016: 8/8-bit single-image retry Recheck narrow arithmetic using an independent configuration. The quality failure still applies; the retry does not relax the PSNR gate. C simulation passed MSE 2.76e-3; C Pass / bit-exact Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E017: 10-bit boundaries and integer reference Use real ap_fixed for input/parameter conversion and layer rounding/saturation; preserve full product and accumulation fractions in integers. Establish an independent precision reference across 13 images. This is numerical evidence, not a performance experiment. C simulation passed Avg ΔPSNR -0.0695 dB; C Pass / bit-exact Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E019: Complete 10/10-bit ap_fixed retry Check the complete ap_fixed network against the independent integer reference on butterfly, bit for bit. Functionality passes. The hardware architecture still requires separate design and synthesis. C simulation passed MSE 1.82e-5; C Pass / bit-exact Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E049: Exhaustive layer-boundary rounding Exhaust all 25,165,824 states across three 23-bit accumulator boundaries. Validate ties-to-even rounding and saturation. No network latency or resource claim follows. C simulation passed C Pass / bit-exact Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E062: Layer-specific INT8 feasibility Try 8-bit weights/activations one layer at a time instead of quantizing the entire network to INT8. Only 8-bit Conv2 weights meet the average quality gate. Actual 8-bit activations and Conv1/Conv3 weights fail. Analysis complete Software analysis Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.
g.text: Try INT8 one layer at a

g.title: E065: Conv2 8-bit-weight boundary validation Retain 10-bit activations and validate mixed precision on 13 images with real ap_fixed boundaries. Average PSNR loss is about 0.07589 dB. This supplies independent evidence for combinations; comic remains missing. C simulation passed Avg ΔPSNR -0.0759 dB; C Pass / bit-exact Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E066: Complete mixed-precision ap_fixed control Validate mixed-precision butterfly output using the complete ap_fixed network. Bit identity establishes when E065 quality evidence can be used by architectures with the same precision. C simulation passed Avg ΔPSNR -0.0759 dB; C Pass / bit-exact Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E071: Packing/Winograd prerequisite ranges Measure raw integer coefficients, transform widths, packed low-field accumulation limits, and paper DSP budgets. Range and budget analysis is not synthesis. New weights require checking the bounds again. Analysis complete Software analysis Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E020: Default automatic optimization, 10 ns Copy the original and add loop labels without changing computation or full-map storage. Latency and BRAM scale remain close to the original baseline. Over budget: BRAM18K HLS 19,601.13853 ms; DSP 10 / B18 11,064; LUT 9,377 / FF 8,027 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E021: Default automatic optimization, 4 ns Tighten only the target period and inspect default scheduling changes. Full intermediate maps still do not fit. A clock target is not an implementation result. Over budget: BRAM18K HLS 17,179.0874 ms; DSP 10 / B18 11,064; LUT 9,997 / FF 9,596 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E022: Disable automatic pipelining Measure whether default pipeline behavior helps. Resource issues persist and latency increases. Over budget: BRAM18K HLS 44,822.23011 ms; DSP 5 / B18 11,064; LUT 2,217 / FF 1,267 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E023: Inner-loop pipeline: invalid configuration Attempt to pipeline the innermost MAC loops through configuration. The tool skips the syn.directive key; the result does not measure the intended directive. Over budget: BRAM18K; II target missed; Invalid configuration Invalid configuration Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E024: Pixel-loop pipeline: invalid configuration Attempt to pipeline the outer pixel loops. The configuration key is invalid. E029 is the subsequent valid control for this idea. Over budget: BRAM18K; II target missed; Invalid configuration Invalid configuration Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E025: Array partition: invalid configuration Attempt to improve scheduling by adding array ports. The key is invalid; E032 corrects it. Over budget: BRAM18K; II target missed; Invalid configuration Invalid configuration Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E026: Allow floating-point reassociation Investigate unsafe-math effects on floating-point accumulation scheduling. Network latency improves little and full intermediate maps remain too large. Over budget: BRAM18K HLS 19,601.13671 ms; DSP 10 / B18 11,064; LUT 7,624 / FF 3,154 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E027: Change only to 16-bit fixed point Retain the full-map architecture and measure changing data types alone. Storage decreases but still greatly exceeds capacity; LUTs also exceed the budget. Over budget: BRAM18K/LUT HLS 3,912.56088 ms; DSP 66 / B18 5,822; LUT 137,322 / FF 8,096 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E028: Valid inner-loop pipeline retry Correct the directive key and measure actual innermost pipelining. Floating-point recurrence and full-map storage still limit the design. Over budget: BRAM18K; HLS timing warning HLS 12,170.25849 ms; DSP 12 / B18 11,064; LUT 9,914 / FF 8,948 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E029: Valid pixel-loop pipeline retry Correct the key and apply the intended pixel-loop pipeline directives. The fastest valid float control still needs about 11,114 BRAM18K blocks, and not all II targets are met. Over budget: BRAM18K; II target missed HLS 3,811.21723 ms; DSP 320 / B18 11,114; LUT 80,812 / FF 123,203 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E032: Valid array-partition retry Correct partition directives and inspect memory-port and pipeline effects. Retaining complete intermediate maps leaves the resource problem unresolved. Over budget: BRAM18K; HLS timing warning HLS 12,170.25849 ms; DSP 12 / B18 11,096; LUT 8,585 / FF 10,378 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E030: Floating-point streaming functional control Connect read/pad/Conv1/Conv2/pad/Conv3/write by streams and reuse windows in line buffers. First establish full-image and edge equivalence. This record contains C simulation only. C simulation passed MSE 3.17e-14; C Pass / bit-exact Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E031: 10-bit streaming, T32 Convert the validated stream organization to 10-bit fixed point and T=32 partial unrolling. BRAM18K falls to 168, but multiplier/type logic maps heavily to LUTs, failing resource and estimated timing goals. Over budget: LUT; HLS timing warning HLS 123.54004 ms; DSP 9 / B18 168; LUT 136,868 / FF 149,111 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E033: T32 single-image synthesis control Shorten the C-simulation workload while retaining the same streaming hardware organization. Again obtain 136,868 LUTs and a 31.822 ns estimate. Inner II=1 does not establish high network throughput. Over budget: LUT; HLS timing warning HLS 123.54004 ms; DSP 9 / B18 168; LUT 136,868 / FF 149,111 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E046: Remove redundant accumulator saturation Use archived range bounds to retain complete product precision and quantize only at layer boundaries. An existing synthesis lock blocks this attempt; it is not a hardware measurement. Run failed Run failed / C Pass Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E063: Accumulator-control retry Measure removal of redundant saturation in a separate run. DSP mapping changes but LUTs remain above budget. Over budget: LUT HLS 29.13855 ms; DSP 148 / B18 168; LUT 95,727 / FF 132,430 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E047: Explicit DSP multiplier binding Bind the T32 design's 162/64/25 parallel multipliers to DSPs. Estimated latency decreases substantially, but registered weights and selectors still exceed the LUT budget. Over budget: LUT HLS 29.13855 ms; DSP 251 / B18 168; LUT 89,341 / FF 132,430 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E048: Integer carriers for fixed-point arithmetic Store fixed-point raw bits in integers and implement layer rounding explicitly without changing numerical boundaries. The simplified representation still uses about 89,304 LUTs. Banking and selectors need further work. Over budget: LUT HLS 29.13855 ms; DSP 254 / B18 168; LUT 89,304 / FF 132,635 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E050: Initial Conv3 scatter Reduce across channels before buffering partial sums on the side with fewer channels. BRAM decreases, but initial fixed-point/mapping logic exceeds the LUT budget. Over budget: LUT HLS 38.82221 ms; DSP 34 / B18 137; LUT 127,718 / FF 128,434 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E060: Integer Conv3 scatter Retain explicit padding and use 32-bit partial sums with rotating line buffers. Resources can meet the budget, but control and extra work make it slower than gather. Candidate; final acceptance pending HLS 37.70206 ms; DSP 254 / B18 137; LUT 39,135 / FF 24,841 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E056: T4 mixed DSP/fabric computation Move some Conv1/Conv3 multipliers into fabric when DSP capacity limits greater parallelism. The paper DSP budget fits, but 237,025 LUTs do not. DSP count alone cannot select a candidate. Over budget: LUT HLS 10.46292 ms; DSP 1,160 / B18 168; LUT 237,025 / FF 120,073 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E034: Initial T16 scan Reduce computation rounds per pixel from 32 to 16, increasing parallel multipliers. C simulation fails; E044 retries the design. Run failed No passing simulation Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E035: Initial T8 scan Further reduce rounds per pixel to 8. C simulation fails; E045 retries it. Run failed No passing simulation Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E044: Valid initial T16 streaming scan Fix simulation settings and measure the same higher-parallelism idea. Default arithmetic/mapping produces a 63.218 ns estimate and excessive LUTs. Over budget: LUT; HLS timing warning HLS 175.46263 ms; DSP 18 / B18 168; LUT 167,715 / FF 135,714 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E045: Valid initial T8 streaming scan Run the initial T8 configuration with valid settings. A 126.008 ns estimate and 266,266 LUTs show that greater parallelism does not accelerate this network. Over budget: LUT; HLS timing warning HLS 280.01057 ms; DSP 36 / B18 168; LUT 266,266 / FF 142,153 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E057: Integer T32 with LUTRAM weight banks Replace fully partitioned weight registers with writable LUTRAM banks matched to parallel ports. LUTs fall to about 44,493, establishing a resource-feasible baseline for further work. Candidate; final acceptance pending HLS 29.83024 ms; DSP 254 / B18 168; LUT 44,493 / FF 46,328 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E058: Integer T16 with LUTRAM weight banks Use T16 in the same integer organization to measure the parallelism/resource tradeoff. About 18.7632 ms; this supplies the parameter baseline for clock and unroll-direction scans. Candidate; final acceptance pending HLS 18.7632 ms; DSP 505 / B18 168; LUT 55,212 / FF 57,723 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E059: Integer T8 with LUTRAM weight banks Increase parallelism again to T8. 85,147 LUTs exceed the project's 70% budget despite remaining DSP capacity. Over budget: LUT HLS 13.22968 ms; DSP 1,007 / B18 168; LUT 85,147 / FF 88,822 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E036: T16 Conv1 unroll direction Shift Conv1 parallelism from output channels toward kernel grouping. II misses its target and cycles increase. A provisional label does not imply scheduling success. II target missed HLS 78.94023 ms; DSP 565 / B18 168; LUT 79,846 / FF 76,416 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E037: T16 Conv2 unroll direction Change Conv2 channel unrolling and its relationship to memory ports. Latency is unchanged and LUT use increases, yielding no better tradeoff. Candidate; final acceptance pending HLS 18.7632 ms; DSP 505 / B18 168; LUT 60,050 / FF 56,509 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E038: T16 Conv3 unroll direction Change how Conv3 parallelism splits input channels and kernel computation. DSPs, LUTs, and cycles all increase. Candidate; final acceptance pending HLS 21.55352 ms; DSP 519 / B18 168; LUT 64,526 / FF 57,346 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E039: DSP T32 LUTRAM control Measure LUTRAM weight banking in the explicitly DSP-bound design. Establish the first resource-feasible candidate. E070 separately measures physical implementation. Candidate; final acceptance pending HLS 29.83024 ms; DSP 251 / B18 168; LUT 44,530 / FF 46,123 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E040: DSP T32 BRAM weight banks Map the same weight banks to BRAM. Many shallow banks waste capacity: 419 BRAM18K blocks exceed the device limit. Over budget: BRAM18K HLS 29.83024 ms; DSP 251 / B18 419; LUT 43,275 / FF 41,136 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E064: T16 fully partitioned weights Retain T16 but replace banked weights with fully partitioned registers. 88,306 LUTs exceed the project budget. Over budget: LUT HLS 18.07151 ms; DSP 505 / B18 168; LUT 88,306 / FF 138,588 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E067: T16 BRAM weight banks Retain T16 and store weights in BRAM. Shallow banks consume 670 BRAM18K blocks, exceeding device capacity. Over budget: BRAM18K HLS 18.7632 ms; DSP 505 / B18 670; LUT 53,706 / FF 47,716 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E041: T16 at a 5 ns target Keep precision/storage fixed and inspect scheduling and resources at a tighter period. About 9.7275 ms estimated; the target still requires physical implementation evidence. Candidate; final acceptance pending HLS 9.7275 ms; DSP 505 / B18 168; LUT 55,553 / FF 59,959 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E042: T16 at a 4 ns target Tighten the target period again without changing the architecture. About 8.0587 ms estimated; FIFO and per-pixel pipeline overhead remain. HLS timing warning HLS 8.05871 ms; DSP 505 / B18 168; LUT 56,007 / FF 62,948 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E043: T16 at a 3.33 ns target Continue tightening the target under the same resource and precision budgets. First-round fastest resource-qualified estimate: about 6.9392 ms. This is not board performance. HLS timing warning HLS 6.93923 ms; DSP 505 / B18 168; LUT 55,325 / FF 67,025 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E051: Ordinary 16x16 multiplier Measure DSP mapping for one signed 16x16 multiplication in isolation. One multiplier maps to one DSP. These PE results are not frame performance. Local experiment passed PE 66 cyc; DSP 1 / B18 0; LUT 62 / FF 16 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E052: Fully unrolled constant weights Fully unroll 64 multiplications by known constants to observe constant optimization. A constant-weight model differs from this project's runtime-loaded weight contract. Local experiment passed PE 0 cyc; DSP 60 / B18 0; LUT 424 / FF 0 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E053: 8x8 fabric multiplier Explicitly measure LUT multiplication and exhaust operand pairs. DSP savings come with LUT costs that accumulate at high parallelism. Local experiment passed PE 66 cyc; DSP 0 / B18 0; LUT 119 / FF 16 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E054: 16x16 multiplier at 4 ns Change only the target period and check that single-DSP mapping persists. Still one DSP per multiplication; this does not validate INT16 packing. Local experiment passed PE 66 cyc; DSP 1 / B18 0; LUT 62 / FF 16 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

E055: Matched addition-only control Use the same array interface/loop to separate interface LUT cost from multiplier cost. The comparison applies to this microkernel; it cannot establish network timing. Local experiment passed PE 66 cyc; DSP 0 / B18 0; LUT 73 / FF 16 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

P01: Two shared-input INT8 products Pack two coefficients with gap18, correct borrow for a negative low field, and exhaust signed8 operand triples. Two products use one DSP, with additional unpacking logic compared with the direct control. HLS timing warning PE 61 cyc; DSP 1 / B18 0; LUT 132 / FF 86 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

P02: Direct two-product control Compute both products separately with identical interfaces and inputs. Two DSPs provide the matched control for packing's LUT and pipeline costs. Local experiment passed PE 58 cyc; DSP 2 / B18 0; LUT 57 / FF 16 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

P03: Unpack after seven terms Accumulate seven packed products within the signed8 safety bound before decoding. Accumulation/decoding costs LUTs and FFs. The seven-term bound does not apply directly to 10-bit inputs. HLS timing warning PE 62 cyc; DSP 1 / B18 0; LUT 299 / FF 309 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

P04: Automatic packing recognition Remove explicit DSP binding to test compiler recognition of the expression. A successful local mapping does not establish automatic optimal network architecture. HLS timing warning PE 61 cyc; DSP 1 / B18 0; LUT 132 / FF 86 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

P05: DSP pre-adder builtin Express pre-addition and pipeline stages with the SDK DSP48E2 builtin. P08 must inspect actual primitive attributes; DSP count alone does not prove pre-adder use. Local experiment passed PE 63 cyc; DSP 1 / B18 0; LUT 127 / FF 162 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

P06: Nonnegative 10-bit activations, two terms Use shared activations in 0..511, allowing at most two safe low-field accumulations. Retain the range bound. General signed10 inputs cannot reuse this grouping. HLS timing warning PE 62 cyc; DSP 1 / B18 0; LUT 274 / FF 424 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

P07: Exact 10-bit coefficient residual recovery Split coefficients into signed low8 plus a residual scaled by 256, recovering results exactly in fabric. 10-bit quality is preserved, but per-product unpacking and residual recovery add logic. HLS timing warning PE 62 cyc; DSP 1 / B18 0; LUT 454 / FF 453 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

P08: Inspect actual DSP pre-adder mapping After Vivado implementation, inspect DSP48E2 AMULTSEL, ADREG, and related attributes. Evidence concerns this PE's physical mapping, not full SRCNN deployment. Implementation complete; check timing separately WNS +2.805 ns; DSP 1 / B36 0; LUT 21 / FF 41 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.
g.text: Place and route the DSP PE

g.title: P09: Frozen-record reproduction Restore P01 sources, tests, and parameters under a fresh ID to validate reproducibility. A reproduction control introduces no new packing algorithm. HLS timing warning PE 61 cyc; DSP 1 / B18 0; LUT 132 / FF 86 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

P10: Exact 10-bit packing network, T16 Pack output channels in Conv1/2 and adjacent output pixels in Conv3. DSP use falls, but 101,488 LUTs exceed budget. Per-pixel pipeline overhead remains substantial. Over budget: LUT; HLS timing warning HLS 12.15633 ms; DSP 254 / B18 168; LUT 101,488 / FF 80,563 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

P11: Exact 10-bit packing network, T8 Increase parallelism with the same arithmetic. 165,606 LUTs exceed budget. Saving multipliers does not resolve selectors and recovery logic. Over budget: LUT; HLS timing warning HLS 7.57721 ms; DSP 505 / B18 168; LUT 165,606 / FF 106,599 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

P12: Exact 10-bit packing network, T4 Increase parallelism further and compare time/resource tradeoffs. 292,053 LUTs exceed budget; lower estimated latency cannot qualify this candidate. Over budget: LUT; HLS timing warning HLS 5.42233 ms; DSP 1,007 / B18 168; LUT 292,053 / FF 159,828 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

P13: Complete INT16 two-product control Directly compute two signed16x16 products with matched interfaces and throughput as the new research baseline. Only plans/preparation exist in this snapshot; two measured DSPs or achieved II1 cannot be claimed. No archived measurements Not run Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

P14: INT16 byte-limb packing Split 16-bit operands, combine packed narrow products, and recover both complete 32-bit results. Count unpacking, partial products, and fabric multipliers. This snapshot has no measured result. No archived measurements Not run Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

P15: INT16 overlapping fields with fabric recovery Allow field overlap and exactly recover both complete products using fabric arithmetic. One DSP does not imply the total cost of two complete multiplications. Results await archiving. No archived measurements Not run Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

P16: INT16 one-DSP/one-fabric control Directly map one product to DSP and one to LUTs, matching P15's resource types. Use this to assess whether overlap packing beats ordinary mixed mapping. No result exists in this snapshot. No archived measurements Not run Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

G01: Matched gather control Independently rerun the same T32, 10 ns, 10-bit Conv3 line-buffer organization. This supplies the scatter control; compare all three organizations under identical parameters. Candidate; final acceptance pending HLS 29.83024 ms; DSP 254 / B18 168; LUT 44,493 / FF 46,328 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

G02: Scatter with explicit padding Store five rows of 32-bit partial sums while retaining 32-channel padding. BRAM18K falls from 168 to 137, but estimated time rises from 29.83 to 37.70 ms. Candidate; final acceptance pending HLS 37.70206 ms; DSP 254 / B18 137; LUT 39,135 / FF 24,841 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

G03: Scatter with merged boundary kernels Merge repeated taps for nine boundary classes and remove the wide-channel padding buffer. BRAM18K falls further to 87, but kernel selection, loading, and control increase estimated time to about 44.14 ms. Candidate; final acceptance pending HLS 44.13926 ms; DSP 254 / B18 87; LUT 40,677 / FF 25,230 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

S01: Global-array DDR interface probe Attempt to export AXI ports for global scratch arrays and examine layer-to-layer external storage. scratch1/2 ports are not generated; storage remains enormous on-chip arrays. This is not a valid DDR implementation. Over budget: BRAM18K; Invalid configuration Invalid configuration Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

S02: Whole-network dataflow control Reuse the matched gather design as the network control for tile fusion. This remeasures the same design rather than introducing a different network. Candidate; final acceptance pending HLS 29.83024 ms; DSP 254 / B18 168; LUT 44,493 / FF 46,328 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

S03: Three-layer fused output tiles, B8 Recompute each tile's halo, fuse local Conv1/2 computation, and buffer a small Conv2 tile. BRAM is low, but halo recomputation, banking, and address selection cost time and LUTs. Over budget: LUT HLS 228.03545 ms; DSP 296 / B18 18; LUT 113,576 / FF 73,880 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

S04: Three-layer fused output tiles, B16 Increase tile size to reduce relative halo recomputation. Sequential tiles still lack whole-network engine overlap; LUTs exceed budget. Over budget: LUT HLS 167.53977 ms; DSP 296 / B18 18; LUT 114,061 / FF 73,901 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

S05: Three-layer fused output tiles, B32 Increase output tile size again to compare buffer and recomputation costs. Traffic lower bounds improve, but synthesized latency and LUT use remain unacceptable. Over budget: LUT HLS 141.66377 ms; DSP 296 / B18 18; LUT 120,033 / FF 74,038 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

S06: Three-layer fused output tiles, B64 Scan the largest tile, including actual replicated edges and incomplete boundary tiles. A smaller halo ratio still does not offset control/storage costs. Bandwidth is modeled, not measured on board. Over budget: LUT HLS 129.81873 ms; DSP 296 / B18 18; LUT 136,162 / FF 74,127 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

W01: 10-bit integer F(2x2,3x3) PE Use G2=2G for integer transforms and divide the inverse result exactly by four before quantization. Local multiplication falls, but transform adders, width growth, reordering, and network scheduling are not yet included. Local experiment passed PE 36 cyc; DSP 16 / B18 0; LUT 1,499 / FF 1,124 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

W02: Direct-convolution PE control Use the same tile to compare 36 direct products against Winograd's 16. DSP savings accompany higher LUT use. PE cycles are not frame latency. Local experiment passed PE 38 cyc; DSP 36 / B18 0; LUT 503 / FF 1,025 Passing C/RTL functionality does not establish routed timing. HLS times are estimates.

W03: 16-bit Winograd PE Increase input/weight widths and measure mapping of transformed 18x20-bit products.
